The New Space Foundation (NSF) promotes and supports the exploration and use of space as a tool for scientific, industrial, economic, and social development in Poland and Europe. It was founded in 2013 to combine experiences and networks from various bodies supporting the Polish accession to the European Space Agency (ESA) and to develop the best model of the presence of Poland in the Agency. To achieve this goal, NSF actively collaborates with public administration, NGOs, research and academic institutions, as well as space industry representatives.
NSF uses the output of 10 years of founders’ experience in the field of education and public engagement (International Year of Astronomy 2009 activities, conferences for teachers, workshops for students, media relations etc.) to organize science and technology communication initiatives (eg. IAU Communicating Astronomy with the Public 2013 conference gathering ~200 communicators) and development actions (it was a part of the IAU Office of Astronomy for the Development project of establishing the regional node for the Eastern Partnership countries). NSF acted as a dissemination node of the Space Awareness EU-founded educational project (http://www.space-awareness.org) and is also involved in the Universe Awareness educational project (https://www.unawe.org), organizing workshops for kids, students, teachers training, public talks, and astro-shows. NSF was also a consortium member of the spaceEU project (https://www.space-eu.org) founded by the European Commission (consortium also included Ars Electronica, Ecsite, European Schoolnet, Cité de l'espace, Parque de las Ciencias, Universum Bremen, Science In, Science Gallery Dublin, Ciência Viva, Leiden University, Ellinogermaniki Agogi). spaceEU consortium implemented a space outreach and education programme to spark the interest of young people in STEAM and to encourage them to consider space-related careers.

NSF leads SPLOT UA – a project of young Ukrainian creatives’ residency in science, art, culture, design and entrepreneurship (https://www.ua.splot.institute) to support development of cross-disciplinary social innovations for post-war Ukraine recovery. SPLOT UA is organized in partnership with the United States Department of State and the United States Embassy in Poland.

entityDescription: The Water Development Department is responsible for the protection and sustainable development as well as the rational management of the water resources of Cyprus, in accordance with European and National legislation and within the framework of the Government water policy in force from time to time. The Department is invited to fulfil a number of objectives covering a wide spectrum of actions whose main axes are the following: ensure the maximum possible satisfaction of water requirements for all uses; encourage the effective use of water resources and secure the quality and protection of water sources and the water environment. The duties and responsibilities of the Department are as summarised as follows: The planning, study, construction and operation of waterworks such as dams, reservoirs, water conveyance projects, irrigation and water supply networks and water treatment plants. Obtaining the necessary quantities of desalinated water through relevant contracts.-Managing and supplying water from Government Waterworks for various uses.-Monitoring the water status and the water balance and the preparation and implementation of plans to manage the effects of droughts. The Implementation of the national programme for the implementation of European Directive on the Treatment of Urban Waste Water with actions relating to the planning and construction of relevant waste water collection and treatment works. The implementation of actions for the protection of surface and ground water bodies. The monitoring and assessment of the qualitative and quantitative status of groundwater and surface waters. The collection and treatment of hydrological, hydrogeological, geotechnical and other data for the study, maintenance and safety of development works and the protection and management of water. The implementation of the provisions of the Evaluation, Management and Handling of Flood Risks legislation. The development of a water conscience for the rational use and saving of water-The management of solid wastes (this field was assigned to the WDD in 2016). As a result of the semi-dry climate, the climatic change and the reduction of rainfall in the area of Cyprus, along with the development that occurred in the last decades, the improvement of the standard of living and the increase of the permanent population and tourism, the country struggles with permanent water shortages as the limited natural water sources are unable to respond to the increasing requirements. Within the framework of its duties, the WDD takes action to handle water shortages and ensure adequate quantities of water of appropriate quality, for the requirements of various uses. At the same time, it implements measures to encourage the more effective use of water, the rational management of water and the protection of water resources and the water environment. In addition to the construction and operation of large waterworks for the storage and use of surface run-offs, the Department also takes action towards the reinforcement of the water balance with water coming from unconventional sources. Within this framework, desalinised water is used to ensure that the requirements in drinking water are fulfilled. At the same time, the use of recycled water for irrigation purposes which is a reliable and stable source of water with important financial and environmental benefits, is also actively encouraged. In 2016, the duties and responsibilities of the WDD have been extended to the field of Solid Waste Management, as the Department was assigned the role of Technical Advisor of the district Councils for the Exploitation of the Solid Waste Disposal Sites. Within this framework, the Department will promote the completion of all new construction works for the Management of Solid Waste referred to in the “National Strategy for the Management of Municipal Waste 2015-2021”.

4D Aerospace Research and Simulation GmbH (4DAE), Salzburg has been founded in 2008 as spin-off company of Paris Lodron University of Salzburg (PLUS). The company has been working closely together with the Aerospace Research Group (Head Prof. Dr. Carl-Herbert Rokitansky) of the University of Salzburg, Computer Science Institute in a number of research projects and industrial co-operations (total of around 40 projects, since 2004) in the aviation, aerospace and railway domain. 

Together with the company Mobile Communications Research and Development Forschungsgesellschaft mbH (MCO), Salzburg and the Aerospace Research Group of PLUS, the company focuses on the development of fast- and real time simulation tools (NAVSIM ATM/ATC/CNS), which allow to simulate the European/worldwide air traffic of specific reference days (today or in future years up to year 2040) very accurately. Based on this detailed simulation of European/worldwide air traffic, a large number of applications, services and future technology concepts have been implemented, tested and evaluated in close co-operation with European institutions (e.g. European Space Agency (ESA), European Commission (EC), SESAR JU, SESAR DM, etc.), Air Navigation Service Providers (e.g. Eurocontrol, Austro Control, Croatia Control, DFS, Enaire, ENAV, etc.), aviation/aerospace industry (e.g. Airbus, AMST, Frequentis, Honeywell, Indra Espacio, Inmarsat, Leonardo, OHB Digital Solutions, Selex, Thales Alenia Space Italia, etc.), research institutions (e.g. DLR, Fraunhofer Austria, Geosphere Austria, etc.) and universities (e.g. TU Graz, TU München, TU Wien, FH St. Pölten, etc.).

The evaluated concepts and future technologies cover a wide range of research areas: Terrestrial (e.g. VDLM2, L-DACS, etc.) and satellite communications (e.g. ESA/Iris); optimization of weather/volcanic ash deviation routes; advanced Arrival Manager (AMAN) solutions and optimized track calculation with ATM/ATC decision support features; Artificial Intelligence (rule) based airport operations, simulation of drones (UAV/RPAS) in (non-)segregated air spaces, ATC exercise and Pilot training scenarios based on Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR; i.e. human ATCO - virtual pilot), Flight Simulators with SATCE (Simulated Air Traffic Control Environment = human pilot - virtual ATC), air craft noise evaluations of large airports.

Together with MCO the company 4D Aerospace Research and Simulation GmbH is also funding and running the "Aviation Competence Center Salzburg" (ACCS), located at the headquarters of 4DAE.

In the railway domain, in co-operation with MCO and PLUS, the company is involved in the development of fast-time and real-time simulation tools (NAVSIM/Rail) which allow the simulation of the European-wide railway traffic (both passenger and freight trains) in order to evaluate the capacity requirements for a future satellite air interface for railway control communications. The methodology concept is similar to the aerospace domain, i.e. based on a simulation of mobile entities (trains) the applications and services of a "Future Railway Mobile Communications System" (FRMCS) are generated by NAVSIM/Rail with the assumption of specific percentages of equipped trains by train category (High Speed, International, Intercity, Regional, Urban/Suburban, Night and Freight trains), depending on the current train domain (station | yard | line) in which the simulated train is currently in. Furthermore, in a co-operation with ÖBB (the national railway service provider of Austria) and TU Graz the simulation tool NAVSIM/Rail was used to evaluate future decision support concepts for train dispatchers towards Automatic Train Operation (ATO)

entityDescription: Istognosis is a software house based in Nicosia, Cyprus established in 2011 with well-established expertise in cloud-oriented and big data technologies with emphasis on Internet of Things (IoT) systems while at the same time excels in designing and developing web-based applications and services across a diverse spectrum of industries such as transportation, healthcare, energy and agriculture. Istognosis invests in R&D activities involving machine learning, image analysis, computer vision, robotics, intelligent systems and networks. Currently, Istognosis provides solutions mainly in three overlapping directions: (a) in the design and development of highly available cloud based applications and solutions, (b) in providing IoT hardware/software solutions mainly for vehicle fleets using state-of-the-art algorithms and tools, as well as (c) in designing and developing energy-efficient and cost-effective renewable energy solutions for private and commercial buildings under the brand name Save Electricity. Businesswise, Istognosis developed and owns (a) the NAVARCHOS fleet management platform which currently serves more than 30 small-scale fleets of a total of 200 commercial vehicles and (b) the ARCHIMIDES framework for cost/energy-efficient PV system analysis and design. Furthermore, Istognosis develops, maintains and supports numerous web applications and solutions for a wide range of customers from both the public and the private sector such as Bank of Cyprus, University of Cyprus, Open University of Cyprus, Costas Papaellinas Organization and others. Moreover, Istognosis has been involved in several EU-funded and RPF-funded projects such as REDUCTION project (7th Framework Programme Call 7), AgriRobot project (RPF, 2010-13), SAVSAR project(Bilateral Greece - Israel 2014-15), BaSE project (EU funded project under the Erasmus+ 2015-16), and NAVARCHOS 2 project (RPF 2018-20), for the innovative enhancement of the existing NAVARCHOS platform.

A story almost 40 years in the making
At ZyLAB we believe that technology can be leveraged to perform legal discovery with more speed, defensibility and depth. It's been almost 40 years since we began our journey to realizing that vision, and it continues to this day. Over the years, our solutions have grown from relatively simple indexing to complex AI-driven projects.The story of ZyLAB starts in 1983.
